root_cause.text: The xHCI debugfs `xhci_portli_show()` function unconditionally dereferenced `port->rhub->hcd` even though some `xhci_port` entries have `port->rhub == NULL` when the port is counted in `xhci->max_ports` but not associated with any Supported Protocol capability/roothub.
root_cause.evidence: The patch notes that the Oops occurs when “there are more port registers counted in `xhci->max_ports` than ports reported by Supported Protocol capabilities,” and explicitly says “In such cases `port->rhub` will be NULL so we can't reach xhci behind it”; the code change adds `if (!port->rhub) { seq_printf(s, "0x%08x\n", portli); return 0; }` before `hcd_to_xhci(port->rhub->hcd)`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix xhci_portli_show() to handle ports without a roothub by avoiding a null dereference and printing the raw PORTLI value instead.
intent_record.what: The code in xhci_portli_show() was changed so that xhci is no longer derived unconditionally from port->rhub->hcd at the start of the function. Instead, the function now reads portli first, checks whether port->rhub is NULL, and if so prints only the raw PORTLI value and returns. The xhci assignment was moved to after this NULL check, and the existing USB3/eUSB2V2-specific formatting logic remains unchanged.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now safely handles ports that do not belong to a roothub. Previously, dereferencing port->rhub would have crashed or faulted for such ports. With the new check, these ports are displayed using a generic hexadecimal PORTLI dump, while protocol-capable ports continue to use the detailed decoded output.

grouping_result.intent: Fix xhci_portli_show() to handle ports without a roothub by avoiding a null dereference and printing the raw PORTLI value instead.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it fixes xhci_portli_show() to avoid dereferencing port->rhub when it can be NULL for some ports, preventing the null pointer crash by falling back to the raw PORTLI value.

candidates.rationale: This line unconditionally dereferences port->rhub->hcd, so when port->rhub is NULL for ports not tied to a roothub it triggers a null-pointer dereference in xhci_portli_show().

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement dereferences port->rhub->hcd without checking whether port->rhub is NULL. For xhci_port entries that are counted in xhci->max_ports but not attached to a roothub, port->rhub can be NULL, causing a null-pointer dereference in xhci_portli_show().
